===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RV1106G2 @1.2GHz :Single-core ARM (Cortex A-7) :VPU (with H265/H264 level 5.0 encoding) :NPU 0.5TOPS @INT8 *Storage: 256MB (SPI NAND) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 128MB Integrated *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: USB (Type-C) port
